text:
emma_finance: Quick heads-up — we're planning a pricing experiment next quarter for token rates (gen + embeddings). Proposal attached. Need approvals and rollout coordination. TL;DR: new price sheet + grandfathering rules + A/B test with holdout.
sam_product: Thanks Emma. Can you paste the proposed price tiers here? want a quick read before the sync.
emma_finance: Sure — high level: small change to hosted per-token gen price (-10% for high-volume), embeddings +5% for new customers, grandfather existing active customers for 12 months. Example CSV:```plan,model,old_price_per_1k,new_price_per_1k,grandfather_months
hosted-gen,redwood-large,0.30,0.27,12
hosted-embed,embed-v1,0.05,0.0525,12
```
liam_sales: Grandfathering 12 months ok from sales side but need a note for renewals >$100k — they should be exempt from auto changes until contract term ends.
natalie_ops: Also need to confirm billing system can apply grandfather flags per-customer and per-plan. @billing-bot can you confirm whether we can set a "grandfather_until" date field?
billing-bot: automated msg — Billing API supports per-customer metadata. Field: metadata.grandfather_until (ISO date). Apply via PATCH /customers/{id}. Docs: https://billing.internal/api#customer-metadata
emma_finance: Great — ops confirmed. Experiment design: 5% holdout (no price change), 45% control (current prices), 50% treatment (new prices). Ramp plan: start 5% treatment, evaluate week 2, then ramp to 50% over 3 weeks if no signal.
sam_product: What metrics are we watching? unit economics and churn, right? define thresholds to stop.
emma_finance: Exactly. Primary: revenue per DAU, net churn rate, and MRR delta. Stop if weekly churn > 1.5x baseline or if NRR falls < 98%.
liam_sales: Communication: need a timeline for sales enablement & a grandfathering FAQ for customers. I can draft an email for customers with active contracts >$100k.
natalie_ops: Ops checklist: 1) upload new price sheet to billing (CSV) 2) set grandfather_until for existing customers 3) tag experiment cohorts in routing layer 4) update invoice templates for new labels 5) run smoke billing test on sandbox.
emma_finance: I'll open a PR with the CSV and config today. Need approvals: Product (+Sam), Sales (+Liam) for communication wording, Ops (+Natalie) for rollout readiness. Can folks reply with :+1: or concerns by EOD?
sam_product: +1 — please add a short faq about how Dedicated/Dedicated Private customers are handled (they usually have different billing flows).
liam_sales: +1, but request: exclude any customers in active negotiations (deal_stage != 'closed_won') from automated changes.
natalie_ops: +1 from ops. I'll schedule the sandbox test for tomorrow 11am.
emma_finance: Thanks — I'll incorporate notes. If no objections, plan to start small rollout on Mon (1717545600) — will send a final rollout plan tomorrow.
liam_sales: FYI — prepping sales talking points, will ping legal if any contract language tweak needed.
emma_finance: tagging followups: @sam_product (A/B monitoring dashboards), @natalie_ops (billing tests), @liam_sales (customer comms).
billing-bot: deploy log — pricing-csv uploaded to staging at 1717462800, job id job_8932.
sam_product: One more Q — can we include an opt-out flag customers can request manually? good for enterprise.
emma_finance: Yes — we'll honor manual opt-outs and set grandfather_until to 9999-12-31 on request. We'll add support ticket template.
liam_sales: Cool. thanks all.
emma_finance: Closing for now. Will post the PR link and the final CSV in this thread after the sandbox test. :white_check_mark:
